# Crawl4AI - LLM-Ready Web Crawler

**84K+ stars · Python · updated daily · Verified Sep 25, 2026**

Open-source web crawler and scraper built for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key.

## What it does

- Turns HTML pages into clean Markdown stripped of nav, ads, and boilerplate
- Handles JavaScript-rendered sites
- Extracts structured data, tables, links, and metadata
- Fast batching for multi-page crawls
- Ships an MCP server so coding agents can crawl directly

## Install

```bash
pip install crawl4ai
crawl4ai-setup   # installs browser dependencies
```

Cloud option: one API key, no local browser install.

## Why it matters for CorpusIQ

Research sweeps, competitor censuses, and ecosystem discovery all need bulk page extraction into clean text. Crawl4AI is the self-hosted, high-throughput option for those lanes, complementing the stealth browser for captcha-walled targets and Firecrawl-style APIs for one-off fetches.
